preConversation.script: Now you'll cut paper into fractions! Use the scissors to make equal parts. Try it!

postConversation.question: When we make fractions, what do we need to remember about the size of the pieces?

probes: If you share a chocolate bar with your friend, would it be fair if one piece is big and one tiny?
When we share equally, what must be true about each piece?
For fair sharing, pieces must be what kind of size?
Think about the word 'same' — same size means equal!
Same size! For fractions, all pieces must be equal. Nice effort!
